subject: microbiology
title: Nematodes: intestinal roundworms, filariae and tissue worms

steps.tx: **Ascaris lumbricoides** (largest intestinal roundworm, fertile **mammillated eggs**, lung migration causing **Loeffler syndrome** with eosinophilia and fleeting infiltrates) obstructs small bowel (paediatric subacute obstruction, worm vomitus), biliary colic with pancreatitis and appendicitis. Diagnosis is stool eggs; treatment is **albendazole or mebendazole** (avoid in early pregnancy, pyrantel pamoate instead), with surgical milking for obstruction and ERCP for biliary worms. Pigs host suum zoonotically.
steps.say: Mammillated eggs with lung shadows then obstruction are Ascaris: albendazole, milk the bowel. Biliary worms need ERCP.

vis.alt: A composite image showing a large adult Ascaris lumbricoides roundworm and a microscopic view of its distinctive fertile mammillated egg, illustrating key diagnostic features.
vis.caption: Ascaris lumbricoides: adult worm and characteristic mammillated egg. Image: CDC/ Dr. Mae Melvin, CC0/PD, Wikimedia Commons.

steps.tx: **Hookworms** (Ancylostoma duodenale with teeth, Necator americanus with plates, **ground itch** with creeping eruption, iron deficiency microcytic anaemia from chronic oozing) are treated with **albendazole plus iron**; **Strongyloides** (autoinfection, **larva currens** racing wheals, **hyperinfection with steroids or HTLV**, Gram negative sepsis, **ivermectin** first line) threatens immunosuppression fatally. **Trichuris** (whipworm, rectal prolapse in heavy children, albendazole) and **Capillaria** complete lumen patterns. Footwear with sanitation prevents skin penetrators.
steps.say: Ground itch plus iron deficiency is hookworm: albendazole plus iron. Steroids waking Strongyloides kill: ivermectin first.

steps.tx: **Enterobius vermicularis** (pinworm, nocturnal perianal itch in children, **NIH cellophane swab** morning eggs, retroinfection) is treated by **whole family mebendazole** repeated in 2 weeks with nail hygiene; appendiceal colic rarely. **Trichinella spiralis** (undercooked pork, **periorbital oedema with myalgia and eosinophilia**, nurse cell cysts on biopsy, **albendazole plus steroids** for muscle phase) and **Anisakis** (raw fish gastric pain, endoscopic removal) punish raw meat. **Ascaris suum** and **Toxocara** (visceral and ocular larva migrans, dog and cat, albendazole with steroids for eye) wander viscerally.
steps.say: Nocturnal bottom itch is pinworm: NIH swab, treat the family twice. Pork myalgia with swollen eyes is Trichinella.

steps.tx: **Wuchereria bancrofti** (Culex, **nocturnal periodicity**, lymphangitis with **elephantiasis**, hydrocele, DEC provocation) is treated with **DEC plus doxycycline** (Wolbachia endosymbiont) with limb hygiene; **Brugia** (subperiodic, Malaysia) and **Loa loa** (Chrysops deerfly, **Calabar swellings** with **eye worm**, DEC with steroids watching encephalopathy) differ by periodicity and vectors. **Onchocerca** (blackfly, **river blindness** with hanging groin and leopard skin, **ivermectin** yearly, Mazzotti reaction) and near eradicated **Dracunculus** (cyclops water flea, blister with emerging worm wound on sticks) close filarial maps.
steps.say: Night blood microfilariae with big leg are bancrofti: DEC plus doxy. Eye worm crossing is Loa: steroids with DEC.
